Title: New Quickstart experience for Web Apps

Body.Content:
Azure App Service gives you many options for deploying your code to the cloud. The new Quickstart experience for the Web Apps feature guides you through the steps to deploy your app by using the deployment stack and deployment method of your choice in record time.

Read the full details in our blog post.
